source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The May front-end confirmation patch prompted in about:message and then delegated to the about:3pane parent, which prompted again when the message pane held focus. The later accepted fix delegates first, then confirms only in the controller that executes the delete. It added a focus-on-message-pane Shift+Delete test and was uplifted to beta and ESR 128. Use this later order when reviewing nested command handlers.
title: Delegate nested message delete commands before prompting
